source.title: Finance and Comptroller (CMF 36) Career Progression Plan
source.proponent: Commandant, U.S. Army Finance and Comptroller School (Proponency Division), Fort Jackson, SC
source.notes: Date basis: 19 Jul 2024 comes from the official file name, the server Last-Modified header, and the Army G-1 listing (checked 2026-10-15). The PDF body prints no date. A separate CMF 36 board brief dated 25 Aug 2025 is a different document and is not imported. Review correction 2026-10-16: Chapter 6 mixes text for the whole Reserve Component with ARNG-only text; paragraph a(1) and items e and f are tagged Guard-only (see componentRules in the manifest). LIMITATIONS: Only MOS 36B is included. Chapter 5 only points to an online career map. In the Reserve/Guard chapter, one sentence in item d mentions ARNG promotion regulations inside otherwise Reserve Component text.

1.reason: CMF-wide duties overview, not attached to 36B.

2.reason: CMF-wide transformation overview, not attached to 36B.

3.mapping_note: Chapter 3 is general CMF 36 career guidance by rank; attached to 36B, the only enlisted MOS in this document.

5.reason: Points to the Army Career Tracker; contains no guidance text.

componentRules.reason: Paragraph (1) describes the ARNG dual Title 10 / Title 32 mission and says the ARNG CMF 36 field is managed identically to the RA with exceptions.
Item e (Special Assignments) is about ARNG Soldiers: no Generating Force assignments, ARNG recruiting closed, Title 10/32 AGR program.
Item f (Additional training) is based on the dual mission of the ARNG and State active-duty missions.
